title: St. Petersburg, Florida
teaser: Tagging along with Trish on her work trip to the Tampa Bay area, and a visit to a fellow lodge.
body: In October 2026 Trish's work brought her to a team gathering in Clearwater, Florida (October 19–21), and I came along for the trip to the St. Petersburg area.
While there, I reached out to St. Petersburg Lodge No. 139 as a visiting Brother from Palmetto Lodge No. 19, and was warmly welcomed to join them for dinner and their meeting on October 20.
